messages:
maria: Postmortem follow-up: recent ETL lag caused missing spans and stale aggregations. We need owners, short ETAs, and a verification plan.

ajay: I can own detection + dashboards. I'll add a per-deploy span-reconciliation panel and a missing_span counter. ETA: EOD tomorrow.

dave: I'll take the pipeline fix. Root cause appears to be a windowing regression after the reorder change. Plan: revert in staging, add deterministic ordering integration test, and run a targeted backfill for the affected window. ETA: Wed COB.

sasha: I'll own alerts + CI gating. Adding Prom alert median_etl_processing_ms > 120s (5m) and a synthetic post-deploy span-count check. Will gate the integration test in CI. ETA: Tue AM.

oncall-bot: Incident record: https://redwood.internal/pms/etl-2026-03-12. Span-drop-rate spike x3; impacted: billing-rollups, analytics-service.

maria: Please attach PR links and add a short runbook entry for oncall triage (triage steps, backfill cmd, comms). Also note recurrence: similar ordering-related regression ~7 weeks ago.

ajay: Dashboard PR: https://git.redwood/infra/mon/pulls/498. Query to surface suspect batches added in PR.

dave: Backfill PR & job: https://git.redwood/etl/pulls/413, backfill job bf-20260315-21. Revert commit: 9f7c2d.

sasha: CI PR: https://git.redwood/ci/pulls/114  adds synthetic run + postdeploy reconciliation. Runbook snippet added: "on span-drop spike -> pause deploys, run backfill job, page oncall, attach telemetry links."

maria: Ownership recap: Ajay (detection/dashboard) EOD tomorrow; Dave (pipeline + backfill) Wed COB; Sasha (alerts + CI) Tue AM. I'll schedule a 15m sync tomorrow 10:30 to confirm progress. Close when dashboards merged, backfill completes, CI gating live, and runbook in place.

ajay: also prototyping a low-noise anomaly detector to reduce false positives from load spikes.

maria: thanks team  we'll sign off when checklist in PM doc is complete. :white_check_mark:
